qa: [Security] effects take precedence for activation. Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Raid＞ ＜Piercing＞ [When Digivolving] Your opponent can't play Digimon or Tamers by effects until the end of their turn. Then, if [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, trash your opponent's top security card. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, delete 1 of their Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon.
